answer.short:
See the sketch.

Dilate horizontally by factor $\frac13$ and vertically by factor $2$.
answer.worked:
Dilate horizontally by factor $\frac13$ and vertically by factor $2$.
$$\begin{align*}x_{\mathrm{new}}&=\frac{x}{3}\\y_{\mathrm{new}}&=2y\end{align*}$$
The origin stays fixed. The other $x$-intercept moves to one-third of its original distance from the $y$-axis. The vertex moves to one-third of its original horizontal distance and twice its original depth below the $x$-axis.
